newsitem.title: USA: Illinois' corn, soy harvests gather momentum.
newsitem.headline: Illinois' corn, soy harvests gather momentum.

text.p: Illinois' corn and soybean harvests made good progress in the week to Sunday but continued to lag the normal pace, the Illinois Agricultural Statistics Service said in its weekly crop update.
Corn was 15 percent harvested, up from six percent a week earlier but still behind the five-year average of 30 percent. Eighty-three percent was mature, versus the normal 92 percent.

"Soybean harvest made good progress in the central districts," the report said. Soybeans were 17 percent harvested, up from four percent a week earlier but behind the average pace of 49 percent. Seventy-three percent of soybeans were dropping leaves, behind an average of 93 percent.
Topsoil moisture was rated at two percent surplus, 65 percent adequate, 30 percent short and three percent very short.
Winter wheat was six percent seeded, behind 14 percent last year and also behind the 21 percent average.
